title: /Volumes/Attic/Desktop/Projects/project-LICHEN/lichen/subsys/lichen/link/time_sync.c:334 lichen_time_sync_update_from_parent incorrectly sets child stratum to NO_SYNC (0) when parent has stratum 1 (CONSERVATIVE). The child should remain synced at stratum 1, not become NO_SYNC which prevents establishing a valid wall clock.
close_reason: Child stratum now floors at LICHEN_TIME_STRATUM_CONSERVATIVE instead of 0: parent CONSERVATIVE(1) yields child stratum 1 (stays synced), parents 2..4 degrade one hop to 1..3. Verified via clang -fsyntax-only (-Wall -Wextra -Werror).
